title: #1 Tip for Breaking Down a Job Description | How to look for keywords to include in your resume
description:
Job descriptions are a company's way of sharing exactly what they are looking for from the person they want to hire. Think of them as the instructions on "how" to apply for a job. Today our Founder and CEO David Fano will cover how to break down the elements of a job description and share his go-to method for how to turn job requirements into an easy-to-answer question. 

To learn more and download the free Chrome extension, head to www.tealhq.com.
